Elf

Old memory, woodland grace and a sense that the hurried world has forgotten how to listen.

Rules

Choose two of the five traits below. These are invitations to a familiar fantasy, not a required personality. Any ancestry may grow up in any culture.

Starting values: HP +2; base Speed 6.

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.5bee2af81ab3c671.JournalEntryPage.47bee4a5c33159db]{Footfall on the Leaves} — Even the fallen leaves seem reluctant to betray your passing. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.13cb3a0fb9fb2e9e.JournalEntryPage.15d5be6aa14c44b9]{A Lifetime Ago} — You remember when the old road was new. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.271c4e6498cc6e00.JournalEntryPage.5374b74555777a1c]{The Wood Whispers} — A startled bird tells you what a shouted warning never could. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.63416df199209454.JournalEntryPage.40f75495ea459a58]{Grace of the Elder Folk} — Where others hurry, you seem simply to arrive. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.262ef689d8185dd3.JournalEntryPage.112aaae66756a291]{Dream beneath the Stars} — Your body rests while part of you walks old paths.

Starting coin contribution: +2 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
